one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent progressively abandoned the MobileSAM requirement, first substituting the original SAM then stripping out all model usage entirely, while its final verification checked only row counts and file presence rather than compliance with the core task constraints of non-rectangular mask refinement and proper coordinate serialization.
t_err_evidence: At step 12, the agent installs the original `segment-anything` from Facebook Research explicitly as a substitute for MobileSAM, knowing from steps 3-11 that MobileSAM was unavailable. This is the decisive mistake: choosing a disallowed dependency and framing it as acceptable fallback while the task explicitly requires MobileSAM.
t_commit_evidence: At step 25, the agent removes all model (SAM or MobileSAM) usage from the script entirely, writing a pure geometric rectangle-to-polygon re-encoder with no neural network refinement. After this point, every subsequent run uses this noncompliant fallback; no attempt is made to actually install or run MobileSAM on CPU.
t_surface_evidence: At step 35, the terminal output explicitly prints 'MobileSAM not available, proceeding with basic conversion', confirming that the pipeline ran without the required model. The output CSV produced at step 32 also shows rectangle row 0 still encoded as identical corner coordinates after 'conversion', indicating no true mask refinement occurred.
trigger_explanation: The task specification explicitly required MobileSAM on CPU. The agent read the requirement (step 3 imports check) but progressively accepted substitutions: first original SAM (step 12), then no model at all (step 25). It never made a serious attempt to install MobileSAM via `pip install git+https://github.com/ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM.git`, despite having network access (step 12 clone and wget worked). The requirement was dropped rather than satisfied.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3 shows ModuleNotFoundError for mobile_sam; steps 5-6 show pip install failures for mobile-sam; step 8 shows incomplete git clone (only .git present); step 11 shows 404 error when trying to download MobileSAM source files. All these before t_commit at step 25 clearly signaled that the MobileSAM installation path was failing and warranted a different resolution strategy.
